program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (bg 0)
                  (ne-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                     (for/or ((c (range 0 ww))) (!= (at g r c) bg)))
                                   (range 0 hh)))
                  (last-ne (list-ref ne-rows (- (length ne-rows) 1)))
                  (cycle (list 0 -1 0 1))
                  (result g))
             (for ((ne ne-rows))
               (let* ((dist-from-bottom (- last-ne ne))
                      (dc (list-ref cycle (modulo dist-from-bottom 4))))
                 (when (!= dc 0) (set! result (shift-row-cells result ne dc bg)))))
             result))))
